# algolia_api_keys (Data Source)

Use this data source to list every API key configured for the Algolia application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algolia_api_keys" "example" {}

output "api_key_values" {
  value = [for key in data.algolia_api_keys.example.keys : key.value]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this listing. Set to the Algolia application ID.
- `keys` (Attributes List) Every API key configured for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `acl` (List of String) Permissions associated with the API key.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of when the API key was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the API key.
- `indexes` (List of String) Index names or patterns the API key can access.
- `max_hits_per_query` (Number) Maximum number of results this API key can retrieve in one query.
- `max_queries_per_ip_per_hour` (Number) Maximum number of API requests allowed per IP address or user token per hour.
- `query_parameters` (String) Query parameters applied when making API requests with this API key.
- `referers` (List of String) Allowed HTTP referrers for this API key.
- `validity` (Number) Duration (in seconds) after which the API key expires. 0 means the key doesn't expire.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The actual API key value.
